reviews.comment: This is a favorite of mine. The tests are straightforward. They have a multiple choice and open ended portion. The lectures were engaging and the prof always had funny stories to tell. You can tell he's passionate about what he's teaching. The lab is super hands on. There was lab homework due every week, but it was pretty easy.

The lab textbook and knives are expensive but Dr. Savell makes lecture engaging and is honestly kinda funny. The exams are all memorization but easy if you study. Show up to class and you are exempt from the final which is nice. Lab TAs also helpful when it comes to lab portion of exam and will give you ideas on what to focus on.

Dr. Savell is engaging in lectures and with the class while also being no-nonsense and respected by students. The grading is almost completely based on exams which is a little scary but he offers unlimited retakes in semesters following. Both he and (primarily) the TAs are approachable for questions and feedback.

it's embarassing how many times ive almost fallen asleep in savell's lectures. he goes off topic so many times that its so hard to pay attention. good guy and easy class but also makes us pay so much for a lab manual just for the homework

You need to pay $120 for books and knives which is excessive. The slides for the lab aren't shared, so you need to individually take hundreds of photos just to study the material. HW is an easy A and lab slaughter was interesting. But lecture can be very boring and he tells a lot of long, irrelevant stories. Exams are straightforward though.

The hardest part about this class is arriving at 8 AM lol. Tests are your main grade with SOME cushion from lab hw. Attend class and get exempt from the final. Tests are purely on memorization. There's lots of material, so keep up with studying. Dr. Savell's a great lecturer- very funny! Lab is very hands on and fun! Best class I've taken so far!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this prof and this class. Very test heavy so study hard, but is very doable. Also, funny as heck and you get lots of interesting conversations.

Went into this class dreading it and came out of it wishing I took it two years ago. 8am lectures are hard, but Savell makes it interesting and entertaining. Tests were straightforward and there was minimal homework. You don't have to take the final if you come to every class. Lab is incredible, learned a ton.

This class is pure memorization, and you have to know every word because it could be tested on. Lab is super interesting and will bring up your grade if you just show up. They allow you to come back to retake tests in future semesters if you're unhappy with your grade. Class was very hard but is doable for an A if you can focus time on it.

I had no background in anything meat science so I had to study pretty hard to do well on exams. Exams aren't hard but they are a lot of memorization. Lab is interesting and can boost your grade a lot if you do well on homework which is easy. Attend exam reviews to get a feel for test questions for both lecture and lab. Good course!
Savell was a very nice prof, good lectures, easy tests. Go to the test reviews before the tests, they are very helpful. Very doable class and enjoyable!

Such an amazing class experience for first semester freshmen! You get to know others and make lots of friends, and you get a free meal every class to boot. The only assignments are one paragraph summaries due the Tuesday morning after each class, and some recipes for a class cookbook. Hard to get into, but worth it if you can.

Dr. Savell is awesome! The lectures were so interesting and I loved the stories he tells. He's a very busy guy but is always available to answer questions. This class is very exam-heavy but if you know how to study for them you will be fine. Attendance determines whether or not you have to take the final. The labs are so fun!

Dr. Savell is an amazing person and really interesting stories to tell. The lectures are sometimes boring but important for the exams. No reading but you should review all your notes before class and after. Test are hard in my opinion but if you review your notes and go to the exam review, then you will be fine.

Took the honors section - grades are based on lab HW assignments, 3 exams (+ optional final with perfect attendance), group presentation. Exams include both lecture and lab material - pure memorization for lecture portion, mostly identification for lab. Savell is a sweet old man with many stories, but wished his lectures were more useful for exams.

Just show up and complete the discussion post every week and you have an A! Super fun class. We got to eat every Friday evening, some of the best food I have ever had! It is not a lecture based class.

Dr. Savell is my all-time favorite professor! I don't come from a meat background so all of the information was new to me. Dr. Savell made the content very easy to understand and supplemented his lectures with memorable stories. The tests have a lot of material, so study a few days in advance! If you attend class you'll do just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: If you can take this class, do it. It requires next to no work from you and you get great relationships and food out of it. The Friday afternoon time period sometimes sucks since it's so late, but it is so worth it. Dr. Savell is an absolute gem and easily one of A&Ms best profs. He cares so much and just wants to see you succeed.

Savell will probably be the sweetest man you'll ever meet in your life. He makes this class as interesting as possible with his stories and you do lots of hands-on activities in labs. The exams are pretty heavy on material but, if you hold perfect attendance throughout the entire semester, you'll be exempt from the final. Highly recommend him!

Dr. Savell is a super nice guy. However, he is not a good lecturer. He went on tangents so much that it was almost impossible to tell what would be tested over. The lectures are not helpful at all, but you can skip the final if you are at them all. I feel like meats could be fun, but his lectures made it my least favorite class.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was difficult for me with no background in meat. I struggled on the exams and scored perfectly on lab assignments. You have to get a C in the class to get credit for my major and I worked my butt off to get a decent grade on the final (B). After everything was put in I had a 69.93%. Did he round it up? No. See y'all in exam makeups.

SOOOO Much information, Dr. Savell does a terrible job letting you know whats going to be on the test. Tests are 75 questions in 60 minutes. If you can't memorize countless meat facts then you'll struggle in the class. He rambles in his lectures and goes of on tangents instead of explaining the class material. No practice tests or exam reviews
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Savell is such a great person. He is so sweet and cares about all of his students, and on top of that, he is super passionate about the class subject. Sometimes lecture can be kind of boring & sometimes he goes off topic, but if you have perfect attendance, you can skip the final :-)
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Savell is a great professor. He is extremely kind and caring about all of his students and I learned a lot from his class. The work is completely reasonable and helped me to do well in his class. I had him during the switch to online from Corona virus in his honors class. He gave us take-home tests that were easy but still made you think.

Dr. Savell is a good professor but the material in his class is difficult if you've never had any previous knowledge in the subject. He's very approachable and tells some funny stories in his class! Make sure you pay attention in lecture AND lab because exams have questions from both. Study diagrams, he'll ask you to label on exams.

The class can be seen as difficult if you have no prior background knowledge. Not an easy class, definitely need to spend a generous about of time studying for this course. Dr. Savell is nice during his lectures but outside of that, I felt he didn't try and help in any way.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The smaller size of ANSC 307 honors section really allowed for good class discussion and interaction. Dr. Savell really made the class interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures--Caring--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is a solid professor at a point in his career where he wants to make sure all students know they are cared about. I will always remember him as a father like figure who wants all his children to succeed in life. He made contact with my father before I began the class to let me know I was welcome in his course. He goes above and beyond!LOVE

Dr. Savell is my all time favorite professor at TAMU. I've had him for multiple classes and he is always very caring about students and really wants them to learn. He is an interesting speaker and is often funny. This class is very technical and test heavy but if you work for it an A is doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Savell's 437 class was fairly easy. You did have to study for the test and you have two projects, a group one and and individual one. I can't say much about how he lecture's because he only lectured like 3 times the whole semester, the rest were guest lecuterers. Make sure you show up to class because they do take attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: You might as well get an average grade because this course is very tedious to read the lab book and the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Please read the textbook and the lab notebook everyday because it has a lot of information for the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: You might as well get an average grade on that! The lectures and the lab are very tedious, but Dr. Savell is a great caring person.
Even though this class is very tedious, he is very a caring teacher and very helpful to all of us.
Pay attention and study everything. He's a great guy who really just wants the students to learn about basic meat science. Will not curve
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Prof, can tell that he really cares about students understanding and is very understanding.

I love Dr. Savell. He's one of the nicest professors and is always willing to help. Study for tests and do your lab homework and you'll be fine. He's one of my favorite professors and I plan to take as many classes with him as possible.

He really engages the class,  even during a morning class I found myself interested.  If he goes off on a tangent it's to tell a funny/interesting story he found relevant in some way and he always gets back on track.

Probably my favorite professor at TAMU. Dr. Savell loves what he teaches and cares about his students. His tests are easy if you study, and you even have the chance to retake tests in future semesters to retroactively boost your grade. The only thing is that he loves to tell (not always applicable) stories, so he goes on a lot of tangents.
Very informed. Cares aboout his students
Dress warm! Tests are fairly easy if you study.
Very fun class to attend. Tests are fair. Able to retake tests in later semesters. Optional final for no absenses.
Optional final for NO absences.  Pretty easy tests, he love MC from a word bank.  Lab learned a lot.  DRESS WARM in Rosenthal.
